description: Enterprise org authority (docs/enterprise-accounts.md). Keys are hybrid Ed25519 + ML-DSA-65 from fixed seeds; signatures deterministic. chains: verifyOrgAuthorityChain(entries, {genesisHash ?? top-level genesisHash, now, freezes, overturns, vetoes}). seatBooks and authorize run on the state of chains[0].entries[0..1] (v0, v1) with no freezes. authorize uses seatBooks[0]'s book.
